_unit: U2.7 — Parent Hotline: live roster + error-path audit
_why: A concurrent unit owns lib/core/i18n/arb/* this round, so these keys were NOT added. Each entry names the interim existing key used in its place, so the swap is mechanical once the ARB files are free.

keys.en: Calling isn't available right now. You can still copy the message to send on WhatsApp.
keys.description: Shown on the Parent Hotline review step when POST /api/attendance/call returns 503 — telephony is not configured server-side (missing Twilio credentials, or VOICE_EXOTEL_CALL_URL unset). The teacher cannot fix this and retrying cannot help, so the Call button is withdrawn and WhatsApp copy is left as the working path.
keys.interim: parentHotlineGenericError (via state.errorMessage, which for a 5xx is ApiException's safe 'Something went wrong on our side.')

keys.en: No students on your roster yet
keys.description: Parent Hotline student picker, when the masked roster read SUCCEEDS and returns no students — the teacher has classes but has not added anyone, or has no classes at all. Distinct from parentHotlineRosterUnavailableTitle, which is a server-side gap the teacher cannot act on.

keys.en: Add students to a class and they will show up here, ready to call home.
